title: Healed after years of back pain
name: Maria L.
body:
For almost six years I lived with constant pain in my lower back. I had tried physiotherapy, injections and more medication than I can remember, and I had stopped making plans because I never knew how I would feel.

One Sunday our small group gathered around me and prayed. I didn't feel anything dramatic at the time, but over the next week I noticed I was sleeping through the night. By the end of the month I was walking to church again.

My doctor has no explanation. I simply say thank you, every single morning.

title: Rent paid on the day it was due
name: David and Ruth K.
body:
When my husband lost his job we were three hundred pounds short of the rent. We told no one except God. On the morning it was due, an envelope came through the door with no name on it and exactly the amount we needed inside.

We still don't know who sent it. We have since been able to do the same for another family, and we pass the story on with it.

title: Finding my way home
name: James T.
body:
I grew up going to church but walked away at seventeen and spent the next twenty years convinced I didn't need God. Addiction cost me my marriage and very nearly my life.

A man I'd never met sat next to me at a bus stop and asked if I was alright. Nobody had asked me that in years. He invited me to a meal at his church, and I went only because it was free.

That meal was two years ago. I've been sober for twenty-one months, and I know now that I was never as far away as I thought.

title: My brother and I are speaking again
name: Anonymous
body:
My brother and I didn't speak for eleven years after an argument over our father's will. I had told myself I was fine with it. After a sermon on forgiveness I couldn't sleep, and at two in the morning I wrote him a letter.

He phoned the day it arrived. We talked for three hours. Last month our children met their cousins for the first time.

title: A job offer the day after we prayed
name: Samuel O.
body:
After eight months of applications and rejections I asked our prayer team to stand with me. I had an interview I felt sure had gone badly.

The very next morning they rang to offer me the position, at a higher salary than I'd asked for. I start in the same week my savings would have run out.

title: Peace in the middle of chemotherapy
name: Grace W.
body:
I won't pretend that cancer treatment was easy. There were days I couldn't lift my head. But I can honestly say I was never alone and never without hope.

People from church cooked meals, drove me to the hospital and sat with me through long afternoons. My latest scan came back clear. Whatever the future holds, I have learned that God's peace is real, even in a hospital chair.

title: Guided to the right school
name: Priya N.
body:
We had to choose between two schools for our son, who has dyslexia, and we were completely torn. We prayed for clear direction and asked for wisdom.

At an open evening we met a teacher who had trained in exactly the support he needs. He has flourished there this year, and is reading for pleasure for the first time.

title: A car when we had none
name: The Mensah family
body:
Our car failed its test and the repairs would have cost more than it was worth. With three children and two jobs across town, we didn't know how we would manage.

An elderly couple in our congregation were giving up driving. They had been praying about who to give their car to, and they chose us. It is still running beautifully.

title: Restored hearing in one ear
name: Thomas B.
body:
Following an infection I lost most of the hearing in my left ear, and the specialist told me it was unlikely to come back. During a healing service a friend laid hands on me and prayed.

Over the following days sounds slowly returned. A hearing test in March showed near-normal results. I'm grateful every time I hear my granddaughter laugh.

title: Our marriage was given a second chance
name: Mark and Elaine P.
body:
We had separated and both believed it was over. A couple from church offered to walk alongside us, with no pressure, just friendship and prayer.

It took a year of honest conversations and counselling. This spring we renewed our vows in front of the same friends who never gave up on us.

title: Safe through the storm
name: Josephine A.
body:
My daughter was driving home through the worst storm of the winter, and I couldn't reach her phone. I prayed for her protection for two hours straight.

She arrived home shaken but unharmed. A tree had come down on the road just behind her car. We don't take a single day for granted.

title: Knowing when to step out
name: Daniel R.
body:
I'd felt a pull towards youth work for years but was afraid to leave a secure job. I asked God for a clear sign rather than a feeling.

Within a week, two different people who didn't know each other mentioned the same local youth project to me. I applied, and I've now been working there for six months. It is the hardest and best job I have ever had.

title: Faith at ninety-one
name: Edith M.
body:
People sometimes think it's too late to begin with God. I gave my life to Jesus at ninety-one, after my great-grandson invited me to his baptism.

I have more joy now than I have had in decades, and I'm making new friends at the Thursday coffee morning.

title: Groceries left on the doorstep
name: Anonymous
body: In January, between bills and a broken boiler, our cupboards were almost empty. I hadn't told anyone. That evening I opened the door to find four bags of shopping, including the exact cereal my youngest refuses to go without.

title: Draft: waiting for permission to share
name: Hannah S.
body: This story is waiting for the family's permission before it is published.
